jobs.title: Nursing Professional Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
Purpose

The Nursing Professional Development Coordinator advances the mission of the Ohio Nurses 
Association by developing, coordinating, and evaluating educational programs that strengthen 
nursing practice, cultivate union leaders, and empower nurses and health professionals to 
advocate for quality patient care and safe workplaces. This position is responsible for the 
planning and implementation of live, blended, and independent learning activities in 
compliance with the requirements of the American Nurses Credentialing Center’s Commission 
on Accreditation (ANCC) and the Ohio Board of Nursing. The Coordinator also supports ONA’s 
professional practice, leadership development, advocacy, and member engagement 
initiatives, helping to build the knowledge, skills, and collective power of nurses and health 
professionals across Ohio.

Essential Functions:

Continuing Education - General

Helps to create, review, evaluate and revise the philosophy and overall strategy

of the Continuing Education Department.
Takes initiative to identify and act on new opportunities related to continuing

education to enhance results and minimize problems.
Collaborates with other departments on issues related to program responsibilities

or overall operation of the organization.
Identifies and follows up on opportunities and strategies to enhance the

continuing education programs offered by the Ohio Nurses Association.
Submits written reports of departmental activities as requested by the supervisor or

designee.
Studies and evaluates matters relating to continuing education and recommends

appropriate action.
Present at CE events which may require travel and overnight stays.

Continuing Education – ONA Provider Unit

Functioning as a nurse planner in ONA’s ANCC accredited provider unit, the Nurse

Coordinator assesses, plans, implements and evaluates activities, including finding
authors or speakers, leading planning meetings, and serving as a planning expert.
Serving as a content expert as appropriate, will author/update independent studies,

record webinars, deliver live presentations.
Assist the Director of CE in the accredited provider unit program for reporting

purposes, including submitting data to ANCC and OBN as required, participating in
the provider application process as designated by ANCC, setting goals and
evaluating the overall provider unit.
Ensures CE4Nurses runs effectively and appropriately. Builds courses in CE4Nurses

maintaining accreditation standards.
Maintain thorough knowledge of Ohio Revised Code and Administrative Code 4723

and author/present Category A content.
Functions as a Nurse Planner of the accredited provider unit.

Continuing Education – OBN Approver Unit

Orient as a Nurse Peer Reviewer to assist in the processes of the accredited

approver unit within six (6) months of employment.
Serve as a Peer Reviewer for both Individual Applications and Approved Provider

Applications as needed.
Maintain knowledge of OAC 4723-14. Assist the Director of CE in reviewing proposed

updates and changes in law that would affect this chapter.

Consultations to Members, the Community, and Interested Parties

Provides ongoing staff services to members and non-members related to continuing

education.
Participates in Ohio Nurses Association committees as assigned.
Assists ONA staff in the development of CE programs in the nurse planner role as

directed by the Director of Continuing Education.

Communications

Works with the Director of Communications at the direction of the Director of CE

on communication strategies related to continuing education using all forms of
media.
Submits periodic reports summarizing program activity to the Executive Director

or Senior Director as requested.
Ensures that all marketing and public relations communications intended for

public release are reviewed by the CE department designee.
Maintains confidentiality of reports as required by federal and state law or

accreditation requirements.
Contributes to the Ohio Nurse quarterly.
Contributes to the Ohio Nurse and Health Professionals Review.

Relationship Building

Serves as ONA representative to other organizations as assigned by the direct

supervisor or designee.
Identifies opportunities to partner with these organizations.
May be assigned to attend OBN meetings or other non-CE advisory meetings at OBN.

Other Duties

• Participates in staff meetings and other required meetings and seminars.
• Attends and assists in the coordination and preparation of the biennial convention.
• Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and work product.
• Submits time electronically on a weekly basis.
• Submits credit card statements, if necessary, by the deadlines established.
• Respects computer and laptop service requests and responds timely when action is
required.
• Provides information on the intranet calendar when out of the office.
• Maintains documents in a format that makes them readily accessible to other
staff in accordance with office policy.
• Travels throughout Ohio and make frequent visits to the Ohio Statehouse. Occasional
national travel or overnight trips.
The statements contained herein describe the scope of the responsibility and essential
functions of this position, but should not be considered to be an all-inclusive listing of 
work requirements. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned including work 
in other areas to cover absences or relief to equalize peak work periods or otherwise 
balance the workload.

Typical Physical Requirements

• Regularly uses a telephone and e-mail system for communication.
• The person in this position frequently communicates with coworkers and
organization contacts who have inquiries. Must be able to exchange accurate
information in these situations.
• The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to
access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.
• The person in this position frequently operates a computer and other office
productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
• Sedentary work – Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a
negligible amount of force frequency or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or
otherwise move objects. Involves sitting most of the time.

Employment Standards

Knowledge of:

• Overall mission of the Ohio Nurses Association and AFT
• Nursing Practice: General and Ohio specific
• Continuing Education
• Educational Design
• Adult Learning

Skill in:

• Reviewing, editing and writing documents.
• Microsoft Office – Power Point, Excel, Word, Outlook.
• Simple Web development programs
• Telecommunications i.e. Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Zoom Webinar, Online Application
Software
• Strict attention to detail.
• Making presentations.
• Communicating clearly and concisely.
• Leading and facilitating meetings.
• Public speaking.

Ability to:

• Identify new opportunities and act on them to enhance results.
• Represent the organization in a positive and professional way.
• Demonstrate a helpful, accepting attitude towards members and others.
• Relate to and establish rapport with all types of people.
• Prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
• Work with individuals and groups.
• Handle stressful situations.

Additional knowledge, skills and abilities may be required to perform additional tasks
specific to work or special assignments.

Required Education and Experience 

Any combination of education and experience, which would likely produce the 
necessary knowledge and abilities, is qualifying.
• Minimum baccalaureate degree in Nursing
• Unrestricted Ohio RN license
• 4-5 years of experience in continuing education.
• Current Ohio driver’s license.

Work Environment

The work environment involves everyday risks or discomforts that require normal safety 
precautions typical of such office environments. Observance of all safety rules and 
guidelines is imperative and always expected. The employee may be exposed to chemical 
compounds found in an office environment. The Employee may also be exposed to 
hazardous household waste.

Note:
Job descriptions outline the essential duties, skills, attitudes, and requirements for each position. They are not intended to capture every task an employee may perform. Job duties may be changed or added, as needed, to meet operational requirements at the discretion of ONA, and such adjustments will be communicated reasonably to affected employees.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, genetic information, or any other status protected by law or regulation. It is our intention that all qualified applicants are given equal opportunity and that selection decisions be based on job-related factors. The Association will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of this position.

jobs.title: Clinical Application Specialist II / RWE data analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Contractor in Data Analytics is accountable to a real-world data and analytics leader
within the Global Epidemiology function in Clinical Sciences. The role provides expertise of real-world data and analysis methods within Clinical Sciences
. Required to draw upon their experience to develop data/statistical analysis plans and execute data analysis with minimal technical oversight. Required to be able to independently deliver data analysis results and findings to epidemiologists or cross-functional members as necessary. This person should be able to do comprehensive literature review for real-world data methodology and coding algorithm. Provide insights into real-world data, analysis tools, and epidemiology study concepts and protocols/proposals.

salary: $50.00 - 60.23 per hour, remote role

Responsibilities

Understand general to advanced epidemiology research techniques to apply appropriate research methods to answer questions relating to drug safety
Be aware of and familiar with public and private resources and databases relevant to epidemiology for use in data analysis
Independently manages data/statistical analysis plan and analyze specific epidemiology databases to prepare relevant tables and figures. Clearly communicate the results and findings to epidemiologists and cross-functional members as needed
Contribute to the design of observational studies, including registries, providing critical appraisal of observational study protocols through participation in inter-departmental and cross-functional committees as needed
Be able to convert sales data to exposure data, overall and stratified by key factors, e.g. age groups, gender, indications by leveraging with real-world data
Provide epidemiology data to core safety and regulatory documents including, but not limited to, RMPs, PSURs, and Briefing Books
Be proficient with analysis tools, e.g. SAS, SQL, R, Aetion, for data analysis, modeling, and visualization
Do comprehensive literature review for analytics methodology and coding algorithms related to real-world data

Qualifications

MPH or MS degree in Epidemiology, Health Services Research, Pharmacy Administration, or related field. Ph.D. is preferred.
With 4-5 years of epidemiology and/or public health experience with a Master degree or 1-2 years of experience with a Ph.D. degree (must have). Pharmaceutical industry experience is preferred.
Proficient with SAS, SQL, R, or related statistical software or other data analysis tools for data analysis, modeling, and visualization.
Familiar with real-world data (e.g. health insurance claims, EMRs) concepts and structures. Extensive experience in manipulating and analyzing these databases is required.
Knowledge and experience in different therapeutic areas.

skills: SAS, R Language

Pay offered to a successful candidate will be based on several factors including the candidate's education, work experience, work location, specific job duties, certifications, etc. In addition, Randstad offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: medical, prescription, dental, vision, AD&D, and life insurance offerings, short-term disability, and a 401K plan (all benefits are based on eligibility).
This posting is open for thirty (30) days.
